responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module supplies placeholder type declarations for core GCC data objects needed by Modula-2-side frontend code when full autogenerated GCC bindings are unavailable. In this file, location_t is represented as a 64-bit cardinal and tree as an opaque ADDRESS, so it serves as the basic foreign-type contract that lets gm2 definition modules refer to GCC source locations and tree nodes across the C/Modula-2 boundary rather than implementing any compiler transformation itself.
